'''''Achillea distans''''' is a [[perennial]] species of ''[[Achillea]]'' in the family [[Asteraceae]]. It is native to Europe.

== Description ==
It is a [[perennial]] plant that grows up to {{Convert|60|cm}} tall.<ref name=":0">{{Cite web |date=2022-05-06 |title=ACHILLEA DISTANS Waldst. et Kit. ex Willd. – řebříček oddálený / rebríček oddialený {{!}} BOTANY.cz |url=https://botany.cz/cs/achillea-distans/ |access-date=2025-08-28 |language=cs}}</ref>

== Distribution and habitat ==
It is native to Europe and grows in the [[temperate]] biome.<ref>{{Cite web |title=Achillea distans Waldst. & Kit. ex Willd. {{!}} Plants of the World Online {{!}} Kew Science |url=http://powo.science.kew.org/taxon/urn:lsid:ipni.org:names:173943-1 |access-date=2025-08-28 |website=Plants of the World Online |language=en}}</ref> It can be found in light forests, on [[Rock (geology)|rocky]] forest edges and in shrubs. It also grows in [[meadow]]s and fertile [[habitat]]s.<ref name=":0" />
